name: magmux-ui-tests
description: Two families of end-to-end cases, neither part of `go test`. test/ui/* drive a real magmux with real Claude Code panes — they cost model usage and need auth, so they are run on demand. test/rc/* are the six remote-control validation criteria: a real binary over HTTP, WebSocket, SSE, the unix socket, `magmux mcp` and a Firebase emulator, with no model, no network and no key anywhere.
